blocks.text: MANILA – Malacañang on Wednesday called for a probe into possible lapses in law enforcement following Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla’s claim that fugitive businessman Charlie “Atong” Ang had slipped out of the country through an unofficial route. Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said authorities should determine whether negligence occurred and identify those who may be […]...
